the HFo proteins, like the HMf proteins but unlike the HMf-like proteins found in the thermophilic methanogens, are capable of compacting DNA in vitro, but the compacted structures formed are unstable and are lost after heat treatment, indicating a possible functional role for the HFo proteins in DNA compaction in vivo.
